items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Jimmy McPartland) does not speak in the provided context. The mention of Alicia is made by the Interviewer in relation to a third party (the poet), with no indication that McPartland knows her.

ctx.x: And I first knew about him when I was just a little girl because he was in the first book of negro poets that I ever owned which was called 'Negro Poets and Their Poetry'. And when I talked to his wife there very recently, she's about his fourth wife, I think now, Alicia, when I talked to her recently she didn't know about this book of poems. You know, and so I read a couple of the poems to her. It's not his book, it's an anthology. But I read the poems to her over the telephone and she was quite amazed.

But anyway, as I was looking at this album, again I see that 'Davenport Blues is on here and Bix Beiderbecke wrote that and I think since we've said so much about him that it wouldn't be a bad idea right now to play that.
